reason: The potato stems need room, and the cargo mesh may provide support as they grow.
expectation: I expect the mesh to form some kind of support for the potato plants, though I don't know how it will be fitted.

alternatives.reason: Harvesting the mature lettuce also seems useful, but supporting the potato stems matches the stated goal.

effect: The mesh supports the spreading potato stems, and the goal has shifted to tasting the first harvest.
reaction: The fitted grid is a satisfying, practical use for the cargo mesh; I’m curious about the lettuce harvest.
reason: Cutting the mature lettuce is the only offered combination and should bring me closer to tasting it.
expectation: I expect to harvest lettuce from the trough, though it may still need preparation at the galley.

effect: The scissors yielded fresh lettuce leaves, ready for the next step toward tasting the harvest.
reaction: It was a straightforward harvest; I’m curious how the galley will prepare it.
reason: Using the leaves at the galley is the only offered combination and fits the goal of tasting the harvest.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce, though I don’t know exactly what the galley action will produce.

effect: The galley action turned the lettuce into a first fresh meal and completed the chapter.
reaction: The contrast between the green meal and the empty landscape was memorable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cargo mesh around the potato bed was the most satisfying action: it gave a spare material a clear purpose while leaving the root cover in place.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was straightforward and had no additional description, though it was a natural step toward the meal.

surprise.text: The sharp green smell and the contrast with the landscape made the first harvest feel more significant than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to supporting the plants or preparing the harvest.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the potatoes develop and what happens later in the expedition, although this chapter's decisions were fairly straightforward.
